text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With summer training camp fast 
approaching, the Trainers and the Three 
Goddesses decided to spend some time 
relaxing together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Trainer Kashimoto and her team 
continued their strong run, Trainer 
Kiryuuin and Happy Meek were gradually 
feeling their own growth at their own 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to the support of the Three 
Goddesses, each of them enjoyed a deeply 
fulfilling situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses explained that all the 
knowledge they bestowed upon us was 
nothing less than the very history of 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She added that Trainers are an 
indispensable presence in the history of 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As an indispensable partner who runs 
alongside the Umamusume, they were 
reminded once again to continue watching 
over and supporting her.
